features: DESIGNED FOR LIFE AT HOME — Apple HomeView keeps the whole home connected, entertained and in the know. All in one place.
UP TO SIX USERS — Apple HomeView can recognise the faces and voices of up to six people and seamlessly switch between them, delivering a personalised experience for each one.

SIRI AI — Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence, comes built into Apple HomeView to help you find what you need and get more done while protecting your privacy. Available in English to start. Usage limits may apply.
INCREDIBLE SOUND AND VISUALS — Powerful speakers deliver Spatial Audio for rich, room-filling sound. The 17.78 cm (7′′) Liquid Retina display delivers vibrant colours and sharp details.
CUSTOMISABLE FACES — Bring beauty to any room. Relive your favourite memories with the stunning Photos face. Choose playful faces like Snoopy or helpful options like Calendar, Weather and more.

ENTERTAINMENT — Apple HomeView keeps you engaged and entertained with music, podcasts, audiobooks, TV and more. Have an impromptu singalong, immerse yourself in a good story or keep an eye on the game while you do the dishes.

FACETIME. TEXT. INTERCOM — Enjoy clear, hands-free FaceTime calls. Send messages and make calls using just your voice. Use Intercom to communicate with people throughout the house using Apple devices.
SMART HOME — Working seamlessly with the Home app, Apple HomeView is a central hub to control all your smart home accessories.
PRIVACY FOR YOUR HOME — Apple HomeView comes with privacy protections built in at every step and is designed to keep everyone’s personal information secure.
